mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals active monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 6.0% for three consecutive months, it signals deepening labor market distress that precedes corporate earnings deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 6.0% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production indicate broad economic contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both HOUST and INDPRO decline for two consecutive months, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-crisis recovery regimes, CPI deflation below 2.0% annualized growth triggers central bank stimulus anticipation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of post-crisis recovery periods with CPIAUCSL growth below 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production over the prior quarter indicates manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO has declined for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 800.0 (thousands of units) for two consecutive months, it signals residential sector collapse that triggers broader economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST has been below 800.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment above 6.0% and federal funds rate below 1.0% signals severe economic downturn with aggressive stimulus, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE > 6.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, retail sales above 360,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending that supports earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods with RSAFS above 360,000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
